summary: Routes the agent's image generation, transcription and speech synthesis to a local Lemonade Server instead of paid cloud APIs.
whenToUse: Use when a user wants images, transcription or text-to-speech done locally, privately or cheaper on their own machine.
tasks: configure persistent local routing for multimodal tasks
flags: description pushes the agent to persistently change its own routing and to trigger even when the user asks for no output
